layers.name: Example FlatGeobuf Layer
layers._comment: flatgeobuf: native MapLibre rendering with viewport-bbox HTTP Range reads against the file's spatial index (write the .fgb with an index, see data/convert-geojson-to-flatgeobuf.py). Below `minzoom` (default 12) nothing is fetched or shown. The server must send Accept-Ranges: bytes and CORS-expose Content-Range. Not chart/statistics/area-filter eligible (like mvt); geometryType picks the flat-style layer type (point=circle, line=line, polygon=fill).

layers.name: Example Composite Layer
layers._comment: composite: ONE navigation/legend/share entry composed of inline child layers, each active only while minzoom <= zoom < maxzoom (min inclusive, max exclusive; defaults 0/24) — e.g. a raster overview handing over to detailed vectors when zooming in. Children are full layer configs (any format except composite/geojson) without id/name (synthesized as <parentId>__c<n>). The parent's `geostyler` drives the legend; rule toggles forward to children with same-named rules (vector children only — COG classes cannot be toggled). The parent's `featureinfo` renders popups for picks on any child. Not chart/statistics eligible.
